preconditions.expression: isinstance(V, int) and V >= 1 and V <= 10**5
preconditions.description: V is an integer representing the number of vertices, with 1 ≤ V ≤ 10^5.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(adj, list) and len(adj) == V and all(isinstance(neighbors, list) for neighbors in adj)
preconditions.description: adj is a list of lists where adj[i] contains the neighbors of vertex i.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(return_value, list) and (return_value == [-1] or all(isinstance(x, int) and 0 <= x < V for x in return_value))
postconditions.description: The return value is a list of integers representing the articulation points, or [-1] if there are no articulation points.

postconditions.expression: all(x in return_value for x in set(return_value))
postconditions.description: The return value contains no duplicate vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(x in range(V) for x in return_value if x != -1)
postconditions.description: Each vertex in the return value is within the valid range of vertices.
